title: generic SDUI blocks for product pages — stat, usage-bar, checklist — and the renderer half of the api element data source (re-scoped from cloud:home by maintainer ruling 2026-10-12; cloud#2777 part B moves to cloud metadata)
body:
## Maintainer ruling 2026-10-12 — scope change (「现在转向」)

This card no longer builds a `cloud:home` widget. cloud's pages stay metadata and objectui ships only product-agnostic blocks; no new `cloud:*` widget is added (the four that exist stay until their pages migrate). Recorded from the cloud maintainer's session; the contract half is objectstack-ai/objectstack#23016. ⛔ Not a claim.

What this card now delivers:

1. **Three generic SDUI blocks** in app-shell, registered under product-neutral names: `stat` (label, value, optional hint), `usage-bar` (label, used, limit, optional unit), `checklist` (items with label / done / optional action; a `collapsedWhenDone` prop hides it once every item is done). Each reads its props from the node's `properties` and, through the element's `dataSource` binding, from bound data. Copy comes from the page, never from objectui's bundles.
2. **The renderer half of the `api` element data source** once objectstack-ai/objectstack#23016 lands: `resolveDataSource` already builds `ApiDataSource` for `provider: 'api'`; the page-element path passes the new shape through, same-origin, over the console's authenticated fetch.
3. Tests per block with fixture data. No `CloudHomeSummary` fixture, no cloud copy, no ten-locale cloud strings.

The cloud home itself becomes `welcome.page.ts` in cloud (objectstack-ai/cloud#2777 part B), composed from `flex` + these blocks + `element:button`, with its copy in cloud's bundles. The warm-on-landing nudge moves into cloud's `GET /api/v1/cloud/home`; the create deep-link is an `element:button` with `visibleWhen`.

The serial wait behind objectui#12190 stands (the plan-tier label key, 「团队版起」). The original card text below is kept for the data shapes; its "Done when" is superseded by this block.

---

Origin: filed by the cloud seat (`repo:cloud#1`) as the follow-up of an accepted PR whose product flows into objectui. The endpoint this widget reads landed in objectstack-ai/cloud#2783 (merge `d5601dce`), as part A of objectstack-ai/cloud#2777. The maintainer's ruling is objectstack-ai/cloud#2768, comment `6118501670` (「同意」).

Done when: `cloud:home` is a registered app-shell SDUI widget that draws the owner, new-user and member variants from fixture `CloudHomeSummary` bodies, with tests that pin the warm call and the create deep-link (the two `cloud:onboarding-next` behaviours), in all ten locales, on objectui `main`.

Routing (domain, type, priority) is objectui triage's. This card asks for nothing in cloud or objectstack.

## The split of cloud#2777

- **A (landed):** `GET /api/v1/cloud/home`, objectstack-ai/cloud#2783.
- **B (this card):** the objectui widget.
- **C (cloud, later):** `welcome.page.ts` mounts this widget and drops the rest, the 「进入工作区」 sidebar shortcut moves with it, and `.objectui-sha` moves. C waits on the cloud pin-pair rule (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709), so B can land and be published on its own.
- The Studio pencil, the hammer and the 「页面」 crumb are a separate objectui card, filed beside this one.

## The response contract

Copied from objectstack-ai/cloud#2783's body. It is exported from `@objectstack/service-cloud` (`packages/service-cloud/src/cloud-home.ts`). Optional keys are **omitted**, never `null`, except `organizationId`. The envelope is `{ success, data }`.

```ts
interface CloudHomeSummary {
  organizationId: string | null;        // null: the signed-in user has no workspace yet
  viewer: { canManage: boolean };        // true: owner/admin/platform admin/service bearer
  hasProductionEnv: boolean;             // same meaning as environment-entitlements' key
  environments: CloudHomeEnvironment[];  // live only (not archived/failed); production first, then oldest first
  members: { count: number; first: CloudHomeMember[] };  // first = up to 5, by join time
  entitlements?: CloudHomeEntitlements;  // canManage only
  checklist?: CloudHomeChecklist;        // canManage only
}

interface CloudHomeEnvironment {
  id: string;                            // sys_environment.id
  name: string;                          // display_name
  hostname?: string;                     // the card title (ruling Q2); absent while unassigned
  status: string;                        // verbatim: provisioning | active | suspended | ...
  environmentType: 'production' | 'development';
  lastPublishedAt?: string;              // ISO; absent when never published
  plan?: string;                         // canManage only
  storage?: { usedMb?: number; limitMb: number };   // canManage only; usedMb absent until metered; limitMb 0 = unlimited
  installedApps?: CloudHomeInstalledApp[];          // canManage only: enabled marketplace installs, oldest first
}

interface CloudHomeInstalledApp { packageId: string; name: string; version?: string; installedAt?: string }
interface CloudHomeMember { userId: string; name?: string; email?: string; image?: string }

// environment-entitlements' body minus workspaceTimezoneSeed: plan, seatCount (the AI seats),
// hasProductionEnv, production and development { used, limit, canCreate }, and the two URLs.
type CloudHomeEntitlements = EnvironmentCapacityStatus & { upgradeUrl: string; contactSalesUrl: string };

interface CloudHomeChecklist {
  environment: boolean;  // step 1: a live production environment
  firstApp: boolean;     // step 2: a current revision OR an installation row, in a live environment
  teammate: boolean;     // step 3: members.count is 2 or more
  complete: boolean;     // all three: collapse the checklist
}
```

## What the ruling asks the widget to draw (objectstack-ai/cloud#2768, `6118501670`)

- **Environment cards.** The card title is the **hostname**, not the environment name (Q2: the default production name is the organization's name, so the name repeats the page title). The primary button says 「打开」 / Open. 「生产」 is a small tag only when there is a second environment. Each card keeps 「打开」 and 「安装应用」 plus one line 「从应用市场安装：…」 listing `installedApps`. No list of AI-built apps (Q1: the environment's own `/_console/home` already is that).
- **A development-environment hint line**, plan and storage, members (count plus up to five), and the checklist. The checklist ticks by progress and collapses when `complete`.
- **The member variant.** When `viewer.canManage` is false the body carries no `entitlements`, `checklist`, `plan`, `storage` or `installedApps`. The widget draws environments (with 「打开」) and members, and no plan, upgrade, install or invite affordance.
- **The upgrade wording** follows objectstack-ai/cloud#2775: while online payment is off the entry reads 「联系我们开通」 / Contact Us to Upgrade, and a locked feature is marked 「Team 版起」. Payment state is not in this response. In cloud it is the boot flag `ONLINE_PAYMENT_COMING_SOON` that `sys-environment.object.ts` reads, so it reaches the widget through the page's `properties`, as below.

## What the widget must keep from `cloud:onboarding-next`

objectstack-ai/cloud#844 and objectstack-ai/cloud#1871; the precedent is `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/CloudOnboardingNext.tsx` at `26b0bd2d`.

- `hasProductionEnv: true` fires the page's `warmUrl` once (today `/api/v1/cloud/environments/production/warm`), so the environment wakes while the user reads.
- `false` deep-links to the environment list's create action with `navRunActionHref(environmentsRoute, createAction)`.
- Members get `hasProductionEnv` too, so warming still runs for them.
- An unknown or failed read degrades to both actions, so the page always has a working button. That is `onboarding-next`'s rule.
- **URLs stay the page's.** `onboarding-next` takes `openProductionUrl`, `environmentsRoute`, `createAction` and `warmUrl` from `properties`, so the cloud app owns its routes. Keep that doctrine. The per-environment open is `GET /api/v1/cloud/environments/:id/sso-open` (cloud `environment-lifecycle.ts:3546`), and install is the `install_application` action on `sys_environment` (`POST /api/v1/actions/sys_environment/install_application`; the one-click HotCRM with sample data rides it). Both should arrive as `properties` templates, not as constants in the widget.

## Mechanism assumptions (for the dev to measure; falsifying is welcome)

1. **The fetch.** Read `/api/v1/cloud/home` with the same org scoping and strict `{ success, data }` envelope reading that `useEnvironmentEntitlements` uses. Measure whether that hook's fetcher can be shared rather than copied a third time.
2. **Registration.** `ComponentRegistry.register('cloud:home', …)` beside `cloud:onboarding-next`, and the name added to `packages/cli/src/utils/known-schema-types.ts` the way `cloud:onboarding-next` is (lines 53 and 83 at `26b0bd2d`).
3. **`cloud:onboarding-next` stays registered** until cloud's page stops referencing it (part C). Its removal is a later card, not this one.
4. **Locales.** Ten bundles. zh-CN uses 「工作区」 for the organization and 「环境」 for the instance (objectstack-ai/cloud#2773, landing as objectstack-ai/cloud#2786).

## Not in this card

- The AI quota bar, `sso-open`'s `next`, and carrying one sentence into AI build: phase two, objectstack-ai/cloud#2778, objectstack-ai/cloud#2779 and objectstack-ai/cloud#2780.
- Loading-page copy and first-paint cost: objectstack-ai/objectui#12187.

## Acceptance

The staging screenshots on objectstack-ai/cloud#2777 (owner zh-CN and en, a new free account through the three steps, a member) are the maintainer's, after part C mounts the widget. This card is accepted on its tests.
